name: Header
desc: Site header. Over photo = transparent on the hero (white logo/nav). Products open = translucent mega-menu, 4 columns. Solid = scrolled, white surface. Mobile = logo + 44px hamburger; Menu open = full-screen menu. Hover 'Our Products' opens the mega-menu; hamburger opens / close icon closes the mobile menu. NOTE: the hero components carry the page-level header (72px side padding, outlined 'Talk to an Expert'); this set mirrors the separate Header States artboard (40px padding, Blue button).
